name: github_actions_logs_stopped
title: GitHub Actions logs stopped arriving
description: No job logs reached the githubactions stream in the last 24 hours. The ingestion token may have been rotated or the sender job removed. Quiet repositories can trip it over weekends. The query returns one row while data arrives; the alert fires when it returns none.

query_condition.sql: SELECT count(*) AS log_groups FROM "githubactions" WHERE job_id IS NOT NULL HAVING count(*) > 0

row_template: No GitHub Actions job logs in the last 24 hours
